BindLeaderInstance.title: BindLeaderInstance
BindLeaderInstance.summary: Binds a follower instance to a leader instance.

ChangeResourceGroup.title: ChangeResourceGroup
ChangeResourceGroup.summary: Updates the resource group of a Hologres instance.

CreateInstance.title: CreateInstance
CreateInstance.summary: Creates a Hologres instance in the specified region.

CreateManualBackup.title: CreateManualBackup
CreateManualBackup.summary: Creates a manual backup for an instance.

CreateModelService.title: CreateModelService
CreateModelService.summary: Creates a model service that allows AI functions to invoke models. You can create a service for two types of models: a model from Alibaba Cloud Model Studio or a model on a Hologres AI node. If you use a Hologres AI node, you must purchase the AI node resources separately.

CreateUser.title: CreateUser
CreateUser.summary: Adds a RAM user or an STS account to a Hologres instance. Once added, the account can be used to log on to the instance.

DeleteModelResource.title: DeleteModelResource
DeleteModelResource.summary: Deletes a model resource. This action permanently deletes all models deployed on the node.

DisableExecuteStatement.title: Disable the executeStatement feature for an instance
DisableExecuteStatement.summary: Shuts down the ExecuteStatement API access permissions for a specified Hologres instance.

DisableSSL.title: DisableSSL
DisableSSL.summary: Disables SSL encryption for a Hologres instance.

DisableWarehouseAutoScale.title: DisableWarehouseAutoScale
DisableWarehouseAutoScale.summary: Disables autoscale for a specified compute group.

DiscardUpgrade.title: DiscardUpgrade
DiscardUpgrade.summary: Cancels an upgrade. You can call this operation only if the upgrade task has not started or is in the `pre_check` state. You cannot cancel the upgrade after the task enters the `backup` state or any subsequent state.

DropUser.title: DropUser
DropUser.summary: Deletes a RAM user or an STS account from a Hologres instance. Once deleted, the user can no longer log in to the instance. To restore access, call the CreateUser operation to add the user.

EnableExecuteStatement.title: EnableExecuteStatement
EnableExecuteStatement.summary: Enables SQL execution via OpenAPI for a specified Hologres instance.

EnableHiveAccess.title: EnableHiveAccess
EnableHiveAccess.summary: Enables data lake acceleration for a Hologres instance.

EnableSSL.title: EnableSSL
EnableSSL.summary: Enables SSL encryption for a Hologres instance.

EnableWarehouseAutoScale.title: EnableWarehouseAutoScale
EnableWarehouseAutoScale.summary: Enables auto scaling for a warehouse.

ExecuteStatement.title: ExecuteStatement
ExecuteStatement.summary: Executes an SQL statement synchronously on a specified database via OpenAPI and returns the result.

GetCertificateAttribute.title: GetCertificateAttribute
GetCertificateAttribute.summary: Retrieves the SSL certificate attributes of a Hologres instance, including SSL status and certificate expiration time.

GetExecuteStatementEnabled.title: GetExecuteStatementEnabled
GetExecuteStatementEnabled.summary: Checks whether a specified Hologres instance allows SQL execution through OpenAPI.

GetHoloWebLoginSetting.title: GetHoloWebLoginSetting
GetHoloWebLoginSetting.summary: Gets the external account login setting for HoloWeb.

GetInstance.title: GetInstance
GetInstance.summary: Retrieves the details of an instance.

GetInstanceModel.title: Instance deployed model details
GetInstanceModel.summary: Queries the list of large model services bound to a Hologres instance.

GetRootCertificate.title: GetRootCertificate
GetRootCertificate.summary: Retrieves the root SSL certificate of a Hologres instance for client-side SSL connections.

GetUpgradeStatus.title: GetUpgradeStatus
GetUpgradeStatus.summary: Queries the upgrade status of an instance.

GetUpgradeable.title: Query whether an instance can be upgraded
GetUpgradeable.summary: Queries whether an instance can be upgraded.

GetWarehouseDetail.title: GetWarehouseDetail
GetWarehouseDetail.summary: Retrieves the details of a virtual warehouse.

GrantDatabasePermission.title: GrantDatabasePermission
GrantDatabasePermission.summary: Grants permissions on a database to a specified user within a Hologres instance.

GrantSchemaPermission.title: GrantSchemaPermission
GrantSchemaPermission.summary: Grants permissions on a schema to a specified user within a Hologres instance.

GrantTablePermission.title: GrantTablePermission
GrantTablePermission.summary: Grants permissions on a table to a specified user.

ListBackupData.title: ListBackupData
ListBackupData.summary: Retrieves a list of snapshots. Each snapshot represents a point-in-time backup that can be used to restore a new instance with its full data.

ListDatabases.title: ListDatabases
ListDatabases.summary: Queries the databases in a Hologres instance.

ListLeaderInstances.title: ListLeaderInstances
ListLeaderInstances.summary: Retrieves a list of potential leader instances.

ListMigrationZones.title: ListMigrationZones
ListMigrationZones.summary: Lists the availability zones to which an instance can be migrated. This operation applies to instances that are deployed across three availability zones.

ListOperationEvents.title: ListOperationEvents
ListOperationEvents.summary: Retrieves action events that match specified criteria, supporting pagination and sorting.

ListRegions.title: List regions
ListRegions.summary: Queries the list of all regions supported by Hologres.

ListUpgradeReleaseVersions.title: List upgradable versions
ListUpgradeReleaseVersions.summary: Retrieves the list of versions available for upgrade.

ListWarehouseScheduleEvent.title: ListWarehouseScheduleEvent
ListWarehouseScheduleEvent.summary: Retrieves the elastic scheduling events for a specified instance and time range.

ListWarehouseScheduleTask.title: ListWarehouseScheduleTask
ListWarehouseScheduleTask.summary: Lists all warehouse schedule tasks for a specified instance.

ListWarehouses.title: ListWarehouses
ListWarehouses.summary: Retrieves a list of virtual warehouses.

MigrateInstanceZone.title: MigrateInstanceZone
MigrateInstanceZone.summary: Migrates an instance to a target availability zone. This operation only supports instances deployed across three availability zones. The instance is launched in the target availability zone without migrating its storage. The process takes approximately 5 minutes.

PrepareUpgrade.title: PrepareUpgrade
PrepareUpgrade.summary: Prepares an instance for an upgrade by running a pre-upgrade assessment. You can upgrade the instance only if the assessment passes. If it fails, contact technical support for a manual upgrade.

RebalanceHoloWarehouse.title: RebalanceHoloWarehouse
RebalanceHoloWarehouse.summary: Rebalances shards in a virtual warehouse.

RenewInstance.title: RenewInstance
RenewInstance.summary: Renews a subscription Hologres instance. You can also enable monthly auto-renewal.

RenewSSLCertificate.title: RenewSSLCertificate
RenewSSLCertificate.summary: Renews the SSL certificate of a Hologres instance.

ResumeHoloWarehouse.title: ResumeHoloWarehouse
ResumeHoloWarehouse.summary: Resumes a virtual warehouse from Stopped to Running.

RevokeDatabasePermission.title: RevokeDatabasePermission
RevokeDatabasePermission.summary: Revokes permissions on a database from a specified user within a Hologres instance.

RevokeSchemaPermission.title: RevokeSchemaPermission
RevokeSchemaPermission.summary: Revokes permissions on a schema from a specified user within a Hologres instance.

RevokeTablePermission.title: RevokeTablePermission
RevokeTablePermission.summary: Revokes permissions on a table from a specified user.

ScaleInstance.title: ScaleInstance
ScaleInstance.summary: Changes the specifications and storage space of a Hologres instance.

TagResources.title: TagResources
TagResources.summary: Adds tags to one or more resources.

UnBindLeaderInstance.title: UnBindLeaderInstance
UnBindLeaderInstance.summary: Detaches a read-only instance from its primary instance.

UntagResources.title: UntagResources
UntagResources.summary: Removes tags from one or more instances.

UpdateAutoUpgrade.title: UpdateAutoUpgrade
UpdateAutoUpgrade.summary: Enables automatic minor version upgrades for an instance. The upgrade occurs automatically during the maintenance window.

UpdateBackupDataDesc.title: UpdateBackupDataDesc
UpdateBackupDataDesc.summary: Updates the description of a backup.

UpdateHoloWebLoginSetting.title: UpdateHoloWebLoginSetting
UpdateHoloWebLoginSetting.summary: Modifies the login settings for holoweb.

UpdateInstanceName.title: UpdateInstanceName
UpdateInstanceName.summary: Changes the name of an instance.

UpdateInstanceNetworkType.title: UpdateInstanceNetworkType
UpdateInstanceNetworkType.summary: Modifies the network type of an instance.

UpdateInstancePort.title: UpdateInstancePort
UpdateInstancePort.summary: Updates the port of an instance.

UpdateMaintenanceWindow.title: UpdateMaintenanceWindow
UpdateMaintenanceWindow.summary: Updates the maintenance window of a specified instance.

UpdateModelService.title: UpdateModelService
UpdateModelService.summary: Updates a model service. This operation applies only to Hologres AI.

UpdateOperationEventScheduleTime.title: UpdateOperationEventScheduleTime
UpdateOperationEventScheduleTime.summary: Updates the scheduled execution time for an operation event.

UpdateScheduledBackupConfig.title: UpdateScheduledBackupConfig
UpdateScheduledBackupConfig.summary: This operation configures a backup policy for an instance. You can set a weekly schedule to back up an instance on specific days, such as every Monday, Wednesday, and Friday at 20:00:00. You can also specify the number of completed backups to retain. The system automatically deletes expired backups.

UpdateWarehouseScheduleTask.title: UpdateWarehouseScheduleTask
UpdateWarehouseScheduleTask.summary: Updates an elastic schedule for a warehouse.

UpgradeInstance.title: Upgrade an instance
UpgradeInstance.summary: Upgrades an instance. If the preparation is successful, the instance can start the upgrade directly.
